verdict.rationale: The only trace of 'JetBrains' in the evidence pack is a bare mention in a generic integrations list (cursor-docs-6) with no detail on diffs, context sharing, or an actual JetBrains IDE plugin; all other evidence describes Cursor as a VS Code fork/extension (cursor-comm-9, cursor-comm-4), with no documentation of interactive diff viewing or code-context sharing from within a JetBrains IDE.
